title: Witting Polytope Bridge
statement: The Witting polytope (4D complex regular polytope, 240 vertices in C^2) is the complex-geometric face of the W(3,3) substrate: its vertex count equals |E(W(3,3))| = 240, its symmetry group has order (q!)^4 = 1296, and it projects onto the q^q = 27 lines of the cubic surface.

witting_polytope.projection: 27 lines of the cubic surface = q^q lines

identities: projection target = q^q = 27 cubic surface lines
law: The Witting polytope is the canonical complex-geometric avatar of the W(3,3) substrate, encoding |E|, (q!)^4, and q^q simultaneously.
